english.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for a living plant.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for plants considered collectively.
Use this for the plants or plant life found in a particular place, especially in everyday speech.

examples.english: This plant is easy to look after.
examples.jyutping: ni1 fo2 zik6 mat6 hou2 ji6 daa2 lei5

examples.english: This wetland has lots of vegetation and is a great place for birds to live.
examples.traditional: 呢片濕地有好多植物，係雀鳥棲息嘅好地方。
examples.jyutping: nei1 pin3 sap1 dei6 jau5 hou2 do1 zik6 mat6 hai6 zoek3 niu5 cai1 sik1 ge3 hou2 dei6 fong1

examples.english: The botany of this island is very rich.
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 dou2 ge3 zik6 mat6 hou2 fung1 fu3
